styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Slides: opening title, closing. One pink italic emphasis.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Slides: section divider, single idea, proof title, CTA.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Slides: content slide titles.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Slides: customer quotes, max 30 words.

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: Slides: column headings, card names.

styles.name: display-emphasis
styles.usage: The pink italic emphasis inside slide titles (size follows the title).

styles.name: big-number
styles.usage: Slides: metrics on proof cards, max 4 characters.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Slides: one line under opening and divider titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Slides: intro and supporting copy (max 60 words on Title and body, 40 on Text and image).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Slides: column copy and card labels (max 20 words per column).

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Slides: footnotes, legal.

styles.name: action
styles.usage: Slides: buttons, sentence case.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Slides: section label above a title, always Mono. Uppercase.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Slides: page numbers with a full stop (4.), dates.

styles.name: attribution
styles.usage: Slides: quote attribution, NAME · TITLE, COMPANY. Uppercase.

styles.name: ui-title
styles.usage: Visuals: card and window titles, row titles, node names.

styles.name: ui-heading
styles.usage: Visuals: titles of concept cards in a row of 2–4.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.usage: Visuals: row text, instructions, chips, descriptions.

styles.name: ui-action
styles.usage: Visuals: buttons, names, step labels.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Visuals: tags, status badges, section labels, table headers. +4% tracking. Uppercase.

styles.name: ui-micro
styles.usage: Visuals: secondary metadata and small initials only. Uppercase.

styles.name: ui-meta
styles.usage: Visuals: small secondary detail (trained, 7 of 9).

styles.name: ui-code
styles.usage: Visuals: code-like names (test cases, skills, models, branches, paths). Mono only means code.

styles.name: ui-code-block
styles.usage: Visuals: multi-line code in the dark code window.

styles.name: ui-number
styles.usage: Visuals: every number inside a card or visual; never Serif.

styles.name: ui-feature
styles.usage: Visuals: feature-card titles; the second part in black italic.
